blind.description: A dungeon trap comprising an archway built from two square stone block pillars covered in moss, supporting a thick horizontal dark wood beam bound with iron straps at each end. Mounted centrally on a metal pivot collar is a downward-hanging pendulum blade arm with a large crescent-shaped axe blade featuring a polished cutting edge. Surfaces are solid, clean, and continuous with well-defined materials.
blind.from_above: A horizontal dark wooden beam flanked by rectangular stone column tops, featuring metal brackets at the ends and a central round pivot axle collar projecting slightly forward and backward.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 6 feet tall (slightly taller than the 5 ft 9 in figure) and roughly 6 to 6.5 feet wide across the pillars.
